title.narrative: DRK - Danish Red Cross - Resilience, Health and Rights 2021-2025 - NGO call Horn of Africa - Kenya

description.narrative:
The grant is awarded to the Danish Red Cross project: Resilience, Health and Rights: Sustainable solutions and support to vulnerable displaced and host communities in Northern Kenya
The stated objective of the project is: will contribute to build longer-term resilience, access to services and rights for the most vulnerable refugees, IDPs and host communities especially women and girls, people with disabilities and LGBTQ+ in Turkana, Marsabit, Mandera, Wajir and Garissa.

The project "Resilience, Health, and Rights: Sustainable Solutions and Support to Vulnerable Displaced and Host Communities in Northern Kenya" seeks to contribute to build longer-term resillience in marginalised areas, provide access to services, in particular primary health including protection from SGBV and MHPSS services, and promote rights for those affected by displacement whose vulnerabilities have been exacerbated by COVID-19.
